title: Teacher Bai's Friend
tagline: Teacher Bai's Friend publish XB NFT on Opensea and create its minting Dapp to optimize minting experience for Bat's Friend to interact with Xiao Shan Cat in metaverse.
description:
This is a most Futuristic Hack to interact with Teacher Bai's friend and play with Xiao Shan cat in the metaverse ecosystem. Mint an NFT, Play with Xiao Shan - Teacher Bai's Friend! Using Teacher Bai's Friend minting Dapp. You can memorize your interactions and activities with Xiao Shan Cat, feed, groom, pet Xiao Shan Cat and Xiao Shan's friends in different places, and go to different places with Xiao Shan, enjoy the unique experience, and have fun!

Q & A:
1. Who is Teacher Bai?
Teacher Bai is a Software Engineer at 🐶. Also a solo artist(https://xb52.myportfolio.com). Teacher Bai love to hack stuff and is curious about Blockchain/Metaverse technology!

2. Who is Xiao Shan?
Xiao Shan is a cute kitten of Teacher Bai, has a great reputation among Teacher Bai's friends. Teacher Bai makes a YouTube playlist(https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLyhupzpahLTYXjiHtCpnlyDx5Wm3jnzwV) to keep Xiao Shan's like updates in the metaverse ecosystem(future design).
how_its_made: This project can use both Metamask and also coinbase wallet. I deployed and verifyed my own smart contract on Remix publish my own NFT using Opensea API, also developed a minting Dapp using react.js. Plus, this project created avatars based on my cute cat Xiao Shan. Almost all NFTs are based on stories we had!
